fullContentHtml:
AEES Teaching Various Post Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Atomic Energy Education Society (AEES) has released the notification for the post of Principal, Post Graduate Teacher (PGT), Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT), Librarian, Primary Teacher (PRT), Balvatika Teacher. This recruitment has been issued for 254 posts. Online applying process for AEES Teaching Various Post Recruitment 2026 has started from 02 November 2026 & the candidates can apply till 22 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for AEES Teaching Various Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 November 2026
  • Last Date : 22 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 November 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
